purpose: Targeted real positive checks for ordinary finite between with unambiguous reference instances.
csv_row_convention: 1-based physical CSV line including the header; DictReader index + 2
selection: Two original utterances selected before inference using the full annotated category pool and zero-API geometry. Each has unambiguous reference instances, one passing target and definite failing distractors, without appearance, size, observer or negation conditions. This is a targeted capability check, not a held-out accuracy sample.
runtime_input: Original query plus the full prepared scene and annotated object table; target and stimulus IDs are evaluation only.

rows.acceptance_focus: Bind the two actual bed instances without evaluation IDs, check both reference orders against the complete desk pool, and accept only with joint parser, geometry and gate support.

rows.query: The nightstand that is between the bed and the dollhouse
rows.acceptance_focus: Bind the unique bed and dollhouse instances without evaluation IDs, check every nightstand as pass/fail/unknown, and accept only with joint parser, geometry and gate support.
